purpose: Teach: 鳳/鞘/英字/天秤/死語/有色/太もも/気密

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、鳳凰のように再起する戦略を立てろ
lines.en: Craft a strategy for our company to rise again like the phoenix.
lines.style: Clipped authority. Each word lands with weight. Direct eye contact, no hedging. The tone of someone used to being obeyed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。剣のように鞘から抜いた瞬間の集中力を社員に求めます
lines.en: Yes. I'll demand that level of focus from our staff — the kind of concentration you have the moment a sword leaves its sheath.
lines.style: Measured, almost ceremonial. Careful with the metaphor — treating it seriously but not pretentiously. Steady gaze. This is commitment speaking.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、英字パンフレットを刷新しろ
lines.style: Decisive, short-leashed instruction. No elaboration needed. The firmness of someone who expects the work to speak for itself.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内評価は公平な天秤にかけます
lines.en: Yes. I'll ensure our internal evaluations are balanced fairly, like weights on a scale.
lines.style: Composed, methodical. The metaphor delivered plainly — not ornate. Underlining the seriousness of fair judgment. Slightly formal register.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 死語化した社内用語を整理しろ
lines.en: Clean out the outdated terminology cluttering our internal communications.
lines.style: Sharp, efficient instruction. No wasted breath. Pitched to cut through — matter-of-fact authority that doesn't need to raise its voice.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。有色金属事業の動向を分析します
lines.en: Yes. I'll analyze the market trends in our non-ferrous metals division.
lines.style: Professional and alert. Attentive — this is business-critical detail. Voice stays level but the focus tightens slightly.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員食堂で太もも筋トレ室を設置しろ
lines.en: Install a thigh-strength training room in the company cafeteria.
lines.style: Flat-toned, straightforward. No apology for the unusual order. Delivered as factual instruction. The confidence to sound odd without explaining.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新工場は気密性を高めて衛生管理します
lines.en: Yes. Our new factory will maintain strict sanitation standards by maximizing its airtight integrity.
lines.style: Professional assurance. Precise and deliberate — showing how the instruction will be executed methodically. Steady, competent tone throughout.
